${modID}:BurningWill.NAME: Burning Will
${modID}:BurningWill.DESCRIPTION: Exhaust a card from your hand. Deal !M!x(Determination) damage to ALL enemies.
${modID}:BurningWill.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Exhaust a card from your hand. Deal !M!x(Determination) damage to ALL enemies.

${modID}:FlailSmash.NAME: Flail Smash
${modID}:FlailSmash.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. Gain Strength equal to your Determination.
${modID}:FlailSmash.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. Gain Strength equal to your Determination.

${modID}:Claim.NAME: Claim
${modID}:Claim.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. Draw cards equal to your Determination.
${modID}:Claim.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. Draw cards equal to your Determination.

${modID}:DivineSenseOfDetermination.NAME: Divine Sense of Determination
${modID}:DivineSenseOfDetermination.DESCRIPTION: At the start of each turn, gain !M! Determination.
${modID}:DivineSenseOfDetermination.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: At the start of each turn, gain !M! Determination.

${modID}:PerformPower.NAME: Perform Power
${modID}:PerformPower.DESCRIPTION: If you have more than 2 Determination, lose 1 Determination and apply 2 Fear to ALL enemies. NL On Exhaust: Draw 1 card.
${modID}:PerformPower.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: If you have more than 2 Determination, lose 1 Determination and apply 2 Fear to ALL enemies. NL On Exhaust: Draw 1 card.

${modID}:Crusader.NAME: Crusader
${modID}:Crusader.DESCRIPTION: Remove all Weak, Vulnerable, and Frail from yourself. Gain Determination equal to the total stacks removed. Exhaust.
${modID}:Crusader.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Remove all Weak, Vulnerable, and Frail from yourself. Gain Determination equal to the total stacks removed.

${modID}:Audience.NAME: Audience
${modID}:Audience.DESCRIPTION: Reduce the cost of all cards in your hand by 1 this turn and upgrade them. Exhaust.
${modID}:Audience.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Reduce the cost of all cards in your hand by 1 this turn and upgrade them. Exhaust.

${modID}:InHisName.NAME: In His Name
${modID}:InHisName.DESCRIPTION: Cost: 30 / Determination. NL Exhaust any number of cards from your hand. Deal (exhausted+1) x 1.1 x (100+Determination) / 100 damage to ALL enemies.
${modID}:InHisName.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Cost: 30 / Determination. NL Exhaust any number of cards from your hand. Deal (exhausted+1) x 1.1 x (100+Determination) / 100 damage to ALL enemies.
